items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Everybody wanted to play like Bud, play like Max

ctx.x: Was it, with bands like this they seem kind of liquid, these road bands a lot of times, and you're changing players. Yeah. Was it hard to break people in?

Yeah, because everybody at the time, everybody, jazz was really coming on strong. Everybody wanted to play like Bud, play like Max, you know, and you say hey, a lot of them didn't even know the difference between the blues. Uh-huh. You know, they figured if you played the blues you wasn't playing jazz. Right. That's a particular thing. But I mean like, a lot of Roy Brown things, eight ball blues, twelve ball blues. Uh-huh. So we ran into some stars who really couldn't play, period. I mean they were bullshitting…
Or somebody who could play modern jazz, but you told them to play a blues?
